=== SOURCE: doc:delaware-gcl#h6bc64690 ===

The Delaware General Corporation Law requires that a certificate of incorporation be filed with the Secretary of State. The filing fee is $89 and the certificate must include the corporation's name, its registered office, and the name of its registered agent. The corporation may have one or more classes of stock. Each class must be described in the certificate of incorporation. Par value stock is common but the certificate may authorize no-par-value stock.
